name: Releasing Laibuson
disable: DC 27 Arcana check or DC 27 Occultism check or DC 30 Thievery check on the circle of gemstones to deactivate one gemstone, extinguishing its glow. A critical success on the check deactivates two gemstones, while a failure triggers the trap and a critical failure not only triggers the trap but resets a previously disabled gemstone. When all five gemstones are deactivated or destroyed, the trap becomes inert, releasing Laibuson.
reset: The trap deactivates if a round passes without any attempts to disable or damage the gems, then resets and can reactivate again immediately.
routine: (1 action; arcane, mental) On its turn, the trap continues to antagonize Laibuson and one randomly determined PC, causing 4d8 mental damage (DC 25 basic Will save save) to each. On a critical failure, the creature also becomes Stupefied 1 for the remainder of this vision.

Effect A colorful arc of energy leaps from the glowing gems to surround Laibuson and the triggering creature, causing 4d8 mental damage (DC 25 basic Will save save) to each. The trap then rolls initiative.

text: Five colorful gemstones circle the glass barrier separating the PCs from the quartermaster. Careful manipulation of the gems, which can be turned like knobs, might overload one or more of them.
